note: In the vulnerable version, MCInst_Init() sets Kind=kInvalid but does not initialize ImmVal to 0, leaving operand ImmVal fields uninitialized.
Decode case 71 for TBEGIN/TSR creates only one immediate operand (operand 0); operand 1 is never created, so its ImmVal remains uninitialized.
The printer for TBEGIN/TSR calls printU1ImmOperand with operand index 1, which was never created by the decoder.
Reads operand 1 from the MCInst; this operand was never initialized by the decoder.
MCOperand_getImm() reads op->ImmVal unconditionally without checking Kind, returning the uninitialized ImmVal value.
The uninitialized ImmVal is passed to printUInt32, which reads it as a 32-bit value, triggering the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value report.
